title: docs: seed-data page still says seeds load "in dependency order" by array position; align with dependsOn
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbUb7TcZK1XUAddUmQ

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding from the contract review of PR #35312 (record 7000000564), outside that PR's files. ⛔ Not a claim. p3: rides a same-file docs PR, not dispatched alone.

## What

PR #35312 stops the data skill teaching array order as seed load order and names `Seed.dependsOn` (read against `packages/spec` `seed.zod.ts` and the runtime `seed-loader.ts`). `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx:835` still says the seeds load "in dependency order" in the old sense.

## Do

Reword that sentence to match the skill after PR #35312 merges: order comes from `dependsOn` (and lookup edges), not array position. Docs only.
